body.p: The pine intertwinement Once a woman felled a pine tree, the branches of which formed a very entangle intertwinement. She thought, "I'm checking if they are telling the truth: if this ugly intertwinement of the pine tree breaks, will the wind carry the tent away?" She cut it off and went home. She looked in the direction of her tent: There was a whirlwind near the tent. As she walked towards the tent, while she looked, the whirlwind carried her tent away. She raised her eyes to the sky: gone. Suddenly the whirlwind came again. Then it occurred to her: she protects herself from the whirlwind with a knife, an axe. She raised her axe to the wind, felt a slight throb on her face. As soon as she sensed this, she immediately started hacking, saying, "Stay away, I hack you! I will atone for sin. " The whirlwind was over. She went to their tent, she had to live in the neighboring tent while she built another tent. Then she built another tent. And she brought the felled tree with the intertwinment back to where it once stood. She prayed, left a sacrifice, deer fat, prayed again, and said, "I won't do this again."
